source_clause: EH7.) HVAC AUTO shall keep the selected setting through ignition cycles.
reasoning: 驗證目標：10.7（EH7）定出 HVAC AUTO 之選定設定跨點火循環保留，單一 037 leaf 對應之，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：第十五軸依 R-C29 標 (10.1)；依 R-C34 補第十三軸排除，EMEA ICS 不補。為什麼這樣切：本節只定出一項保留行為，無分支可分。刻意略過：條文未區分保留者為 AUTO ECO 抑或 AUTO ON，故 procedure 以 AUTO ECO 為設定值而 ER 判「與點火前相同」，不宣稱其對另一狀態亦成立（§8.4.2 禁範圍造值）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: climate screen 之 AUTO 狀態（跨點火循環）
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 不暴露 —— 可觀察量為 climate screen 之 AUTO 控制，非 head unit 之 comfort section
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（3 旋鈕 ICS 車上無 HVAC 畫面／popup）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不補** —— ch16 十八節無 ECO HVAC 之對應節（`ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 ch10 側全無列），排除即無所依據；本組非 no-counterpart 之「已列而無對造」，而是 ch10 從未進入該表之比對範圍，理由相同：ch16 不承載此章之能力

tcs.tc_title: AUTO setting survives an ignition cycle
tcs.test_item:
EH7.) HVAC AUTO shall keep the selected setting through ignition cycles.

(read the AUTO state on the climate screen -> The AUTO state is AUTO ECO)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EV vehicle, on which ECO HVAC is used (10.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the AUTO button until the AUTO ECO mode is active
2. Run an ignition cycle
3. Read the AUTO state on the climate screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The AUTO state is AUTO ECO
2. The ignition cycle completes
3. The AUTO state is AUTO ECO
tcs.test_item_authored: HVAC AUTO shall keep the selected setting through ignition cycles
